text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.65% today as oil prices climbed on geopolitical tension. Brent crude jumped above $90 a barrel following U.S. strikes on Iranian targets, and the broader oil market is also processing the Trump administration's announced majority control of Venezuela's 65 billion oil reserves and plans to meet with U.S. refiners about boosting capacity. For an oil producer like ConocoPhillips, higher crude prices translate directly to stronger margins and revenue.

The company has also benefited from a modest recovery over the past week—the stock bounced from $129.52 on Thursday to $132.50 today—as the market digested these supportive headlines. The combination of near-term geopolitical risk premium in oil prices and longer-term supply-side developments (Venezuela deal, refining capacity talks) has favored energy stocks.
